causes.1: Wrong or incomplete order lookup (missed, mixed up or never opened the right order)
causes.2: Changed the database without an explicit yes, or before the facts were in (locked order, own choice of payment or reason)
causes.3: Wrong or invented values, or said something different from what it did
causes.4: Cancelled a whole order for a one-item request
causes.5: Account lookup dead end: gave up, or invented details
causes.7: Did not state the required information (database was right)
causes.8: Transferred to a human when the task was doable
